findings.title: Missing HSTS Header
findings.description: The server response does not include the Strict-Transport-Security header.
findings.impact: Without HSTS, browsers may be more exposed to downgrade or first-connection interception risks.
findings.recommendation: Configure Strict-Transport-Security with an appropriate max-age value after confirming HTTPS is correctly configured.

findings.title: Missing Content Security Policy
findings.description: The server response does not include a Content-Security-Policy header.
findings.impact: The absence of CSP removes an important browser-side security control that can reduce the impact of some cross-site scripting attacks.
findings.recommendation: Consider implementing a Content-Security-Policy appropriate for the application's resources.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options Header
findings.description: The server response does not include the X-Content-Type-Options header.
findings.impact: Browsers may perform MIME-type sniffing in situations where explicitly disabling sniffing would provide additional protection.

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options Header
findings.description: The server response does not include the X-Frame-Options header.
findings.impact: The application may have less protection against certain clickjacking scenarios.
findings.recommendation: Consider configuring X-Frame-Options or an equivalent frame-ancestors directive in Content-Security-Policy.

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy Header
findings.description: The server response does not include the Referrer-Policy header.
findings.impact: The browser may disclose more referrer information than necessary when navigating between resources.
findings.recommendation: Consider configuring a restrictive Referrer-Policy appropriate for the application.
